description: Update a project the caller belongs to. action submit sends a draft or unpublished project for review. An edit to a published project, including primaryLang or the other language, stays off the live page until it is approved. One project write when the content changes.

action.description: save or submit. submit asks for review.

primaryLang.description: Primary language: en or ru. Omit it to keep the current one.

sections.description: Replacement headed Markdown sections. Headings and markdown together stay at or under 20 KB.

translation.description: The other language. Null removes it. Omit it to keep the current one. A published change waits for review.

images.description: Captions for image ids that are already on the project.

lang.description: The other language: en or ru.

sections.description: Headed Markdown in the other language. Headings and markdown together stay at or under 20 KB.

markdown.description: Section markdown. No HTML, secrets, payment details, financial promises, or other brands.

name: update_project
title: Update a project
